name: Inline Edit
description: Text that turns into a field in place when you click it, and saves when you press Enter or click away.

props.name: value
props.description: The saved text, when you control it. Use defaultValue to leave it uncontrolled.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The saved text to start with.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with the new text once a save has succeeded. Not called while typing.

props.name: onSave
props.description: Called when the user saves a changed value. Return a promise to keep the field read-only with a spinner until it settles; if it rejects, the field stays open with the error's message below it. Not called when the text is unchanged.

props.name: onCancel
props.description: Called when an edit is abandoned with Escape, the cancel button, or a blur while submitOnBlur is false.

props.name: validate
props.description: Runs before saving. Return a message to keep the field open and show it as an error.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Muted text shown at rest while the value is empty, and in the empty field.

props.name: as
props.description: The element rendered, at rest and while editing. The text and the field inherit its font, so style it with className.

props.name: multiline
props.description: Edits in a growing textarea. Enter adds a line; ⌘Enter or Ctrl+Enter saves.

props.name: submitOnBlur
props.description: Saves when focus leaves the field. When false, leaving the field cancels the edit.

props.name: showButtons
props.description: Adds small save and cancel buttons after the field.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the field. The text at rest is a button named "Edit" followed by the label.

props.name: isDisabled
props.description: Shows the text without the hover wash, the pencil or the button.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the root element, such as its font size and weight. Also accepts the other HTML attributes of that element.
